direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh, no page scroll, only inspector and task lists scroll internally
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary #A8F04A on #050705, one per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text as the required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular alignment for quantities, time and cost
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on a real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible focus ring on every interactive element
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo at left and Lock recovery room at right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; StepRail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, never conflating controls or status; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Remove the extra logo-like mark above the inspector; keep only the header logo here and the opening-story placement, at native aspect.
Enlarge the 120 versus 80 tracks and move DOES NOT MATCH into the gap with clear aligned endpoints for both quantities.
Give SVG nodes a 2px focus ring and bidirectional highlight so selecting ev-cert-qty or ev-recv-qty lights the matching machine and source line.
Refit the inspector into two labelled groups: Pre-flight route health showing nonce and identity status separately, then the distinct Investigation task with its own route select and action.
Add explicit statuses beside route health, for example Offline sample and No request made, so pre-flight is never read as an investigation result.
Keep one primary Run Sample investigation in the DecisionBar and demote any repeated action inside the panel to plain text.
Preserve that selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; keep the exact phrase, character count and disabled Accept state visible without internal scrolling at 1366x768.
Align 83h/$0.00, 35h/$3,115.00 and 17.5h/$3,202.50 in tabular columns and mark the selected path with text plus border, not colour alone.
Add a visible focus ring to each Select this path control and announce the selected option through aria-live polite.
Keep PROPOSED tasks labelled untracked until approval in both the stage banner and each task card; show 0 tracked beside the primary Approve action.
Enlarge the neon recovery flow labels so 40 and 30 via CELL-MILL-1 and MAT-ALLOY-B 70 parts remain legible over the stage grid.
Move Decline proposal to a clear secondary button with a focus ring instead of a low-contrast text link.
Label CELL-MILL-2 as PREVIEW WILL GO OFFLINE with dashed silver outline before applying; reserve stoppedRed for after the shock is applied.
Keep the invalidation warning adjacent to the machine select and repeat it in the DecisionBar centre status.
Disable or visually separate Start a fresh scenario so it cannot be mistaken for the primary Apply second shock action.
Apply stoppedRed only to CELL-MILL-2 with cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; keep all other machines silver, neon only for feasible routes, and no route through that cell.
Repeat the separated inspector pattern: pre-flight nonce and identity health as its own group, distinct from the Reinvestigate recovery evidence task and its primary.
Show 3 to 2 feasible paths and the constrained Split option as text chips on the stage so the capacity change reads without opening the inspector.
Keep the revised typed consent form tied to the newly selected feasible option, with Scenario changed review required and Accept disabled until the exact phrase matches.
Give the constrained Split card hatch pattern, X marker and Split requires at least two online compatible cells text; blank its finish and cost with dashes as shown.
Reduce inspector height pressure by tightening comparison card padding so the consent input and status stay fully visible in the viewport.
Separate three zones in the inspector: Prior tracked work 3 BLOCKED, Approved revised plan, and Replacement proposals PROPOSED untracked until approval, each with its own heading and count.
Shorten the repeating blocked explanation per task to one line with an expandable detail, so t1 and t2 proposals are visible without scrolling at 1366x768.
Add pattern plus text to blocked task rows so status does not rely on colour or the stage legend alone.
Sequence the inspector as three distinct actions: passphrase field, Seal encrypted packet, Verify ledger, then Export independent checkpoint, with only one primary enabled at a time.
Replace duplicate Verify ledger in both inspector and DecisionBar with one primary location and a centre status in the bar to avoid conflicting actions.
Show passphrase rules as 16-160 chars with live count and unmet requirements as text, keeping the field and next action visible without scrolling.
Keep Recovery complete as a terminal state with Back only as navigation; remove any implication of a further primary step and state Packet sealed in the DecisionBar centre.
Add a compact completion summary in the inspector: 18 events, revised plan accepted, CELL-MILL-2 offline retained, with Seal and Verify each marked Complete current ledger.
Ensure the red stopped treatment remains only on CELL-MILL-2 in the final SVG and that the sealed ledger chain uses pattern and SEALED text, not glow.
